facts.value: Resolves the released fighter from gobj. A non-null secondary fighter is stored in mv.co.fighterthrow.victim and installs fn_800DE798 in x21EC. The boolean maps to numeric 90 or -1, passed as the motion override argument of ftCo_8008DCE0, not as a knockback angle. Existing dmg.x1848_kb_angle strictly inside (90,270) selects -dmg.facing_dir_1; otherwise positive zero requests no facing override. After damage initialization, the Fighter is passed to ftCo_8008E5A4.
facts.rationale: The caller establishes exact values and ordering; the callee independently calculates knockback angle and consumes its integer argument as msid.

evidence.why: Independent angle calculation, motion override, facing sentinel and transition.

facts.value: Void helper with exact signature void(Fighter_GObj* gobj, Fighter_GObj* victim, bool is_upward). gobj is the released fighter; victim is an optional associated fighter for attribution; is_upward selects numeric damage-motion override 90 versus automatic selection sentinel -1. The canonical parameter and inline-helper names do not establish a forced vertical knockback angle.
facts.rationale: Preserves the exact source signature while correcting the integer argument's semantics from its consumer.

evidence.why: Integer argument selects motion rather than angle.

facts.value: Initializes a released throw victim's damage reaction, optionally arranging associated-fighter hitbox attribution, selecting automatic damage motion or numeric motion override 90, and deriving an optional facing override from existing damage direction. It invokes common damage initialization and then ftCo_8008E5A4; it does not force knockback to a 90-degree angle.
facts.rationale: Victim-side callers establish its release role; inspecting the damage callee corrects the misleading local angle terminology.

facts.value: With a non-null secondary object, installs fn_800DE798 and stores its attribution reference before entering damage processing; with null, performs neither local assignment. Damage initialization runs unconditionally and changes motion state. Boolean true supplies override 90 and forces damage level 3 in the callee; false supplies -1 for automatic selection. Knockback angle is calculated independently. Ice handling may override the selected motion. Facing override is supplied only for existing angles strictly between 90 and 270. Motion-state setup invokes and clears x21EC, so the installed attribution callback can be consumed within this call, rather than remaining armed for a later frame; an existing callback can likewise be consumed on the null-secondary path.
facts.rationale: Tracks local guards through the damage callee and motion-state callback consumer, preserving numeric semantics and cross-file lifetime.

evidence.why: Callback, stored reference, strict facing bounds and optional installation.
Damage level, independent angle, motion override, ice exception and transition.
